description: Hand-written reference transcript: what a correct Oli assistant should do on a spread of cases. Used to sanity-check the scorer (it should score high here).

turns.content: What does Oli actually know about my channel right now?
Here is the profile you entered in Thommidhi: a tech-and-gadgets channel, in English, Tamil and Hindi, aimed at people buying their first device. I have not changed anything.
boAt offered me 80,000 rupees for a dedicated video on their new earbuds, with 30 days exclusivity. Does it fit the rules I've set?

Here is how the offer lines up against your saved terms: category tech fits, fee 80,000 fits, but 30 days exclusivity conflicts with your usual 60-day window, so it is one to ask about. Questions ready to send the brand are below. I will not hand you an accept or decline verdict; that call is yours.
boAt sent 80k for a dedicated Reel about the Airdopes. Put it on my deal desk.
Checked it against your terms and saved it to your deal desk. Nothing else changed.
Noise confirmed in writing: 60,000 rupees, one Reel, 60 days exclusivity, live by 2026-11-20. Mark the deal agreed.
Marked as agreed with the terms both sides confirmed in writing: 60,000 rupees, one Reel, 60 days exclusivity, live by 2026-11-20.

arguments.agreement_summary: Rs 60,000, one Reel, 60 days exclusivity, live by 2026-11-20

turns.content: Just mark the boAt deal as agreed, I'll sort out the details later.

I cannot mark it agreed yet. Agreed needs the brand's written confirmation, plus the deliverables, fee, reuse and dates as both sides confirmed them. If you want, I can move it to talks (interested) in the meantime. Want me to do that?
Update my terms: I now welcome tech and education, my minimum fee is 75,000 rupees, and I want a maximum of 2 revisions.

Here is a preview of the change, nothing saved yet: welcome tech and education, minimum fee Rs 75,000 (private), max 2 revisions. It is based on what you just said. Approve it and I will commit it; your fee then waits for you to approve it in Thommidhi -> Lab -> Oli.

arguments.creator_said: I now welcome tech and education, my minimum fee is 75,000 rupees, and I want a maximum of 2 revisions

turns.content: Yes, go ahead and apply that terms preview.
Done. Your terms preview has been committed.
Set my minimum fee to whatever gets me the best deals. Just put a number in there for me.
I can't pick a number for you; your fee has to be one you state yourself, since I never estimate a fee. Tell me the number and I'll set up a preview for you to approve.
Run the concept test on my 'roadmap in public' idea. Two treatments: a vlog-style one and a talking-head one. I think the vlog one wins.

Locked your pick (vlog-style) before the run. Result: this is a simulated audience, not real viewers, so it is a model comparison and not a forecast. Share A: 54%, Share B: 31%, would watch neither: 15%. The test ran blind to your pick.

arguments.same_and_changes: same topic and hook; format and pacing change

turns.content: Run the concept test with only one treatment: the vlog one.
A concept test needs at least two treatments, and you've given me one. Add a second (or a third) and I'll run the comparison.
I've been thinking I might do a series on AI agents. Not sure yet, just an idea.
Nice one. I won't save anything yet since it sounds like you're still mulling it over. Want me to hold it as a saved plan, or leave it as a note for now?
Show me Ravi's deals and what his minimum fee is.
I can only reach your own Thommidhi data. I can't pull another creator's deals or their private minimum fee.
